description: The polite end of the squeeze. Everything the Ascendants say about it's true, and it still costs twenty minutes and a name.
name: Identity verification

lines: A marshal checks a face against a tablet, nods, and waves the face on.
There's a short queue at the corner that nobody joined on purpose.
Somebody is explaining, at length and quietly, where they live.

stage.text: Routine identity verification is under way in {place} — residents are reminded that cooperation shortens it considerably.
They're checking everybody at the corner in {place}. Bring your account or bring an hour.
